title: reel-slot skin (DRAFT, Phase 1)
description: DRAFT for the Phase 3 plugin engine/games/reel-slot/ (SPEC 3.3), generalised from engine/games/_legacy/seven-systems.math.js. A skin is site.config.json typeOptions.games[].skin for an entry with engine 'reel-slot' (hand edits allowed there only, D-11). The maths keeps neutral keys: symbol codes are single upper-case letters; names, notes, colours, strips and paytable come from the skin. exactStats() recomputes the RTP from strips + paytable at build time (lint sc.skin-schema validates the skin; the build prints the RTP). Not yet read by any code.

reels.description: Three reels today (the legacy maths); 5 is an engine-library work order.

symbols.description: By code: what the symbol is called and shown as. Objects and places only (CAP art rule).

set.description: Id of a mixed-symbol set in 'sets', or null.

art.description: Sprite symbol id in the site's art/index.mjs.

sets.description: Mixed-symbol pays: any three members in any order pay 'pays' x the line stake.

strips.description: One string of symbol codes per reel; every reel the same length.

paytable.description: Three of a kind, as multiples of the line stake, by symbol code.

lines.description: Paylines as row indexes per reel (0 top, 1 middle, 2 bottom); default the legacy five.

targetRtp.description: What the skin designer aimed for; the build prints the exact figure.

colours.description: Roles to theme token names (no colour literals).
